options.title: BMW M4 frontal · luces y gotas · derecha
options.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE individual landscape 16:9 photorealistic automotive background, NOT a collage. The attached image is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: use its extreme restraint, single thin sculpted light tracing real body contours, car emerging from near-black, no environment. Do NOT copy its model or turn this into vector art. Photograph an actual existing recognizable sports car, physically accurate model proportions, real metal, glass and rubber, not an invented vehicle. Low-key automotive silhouette photography: almost all body surface stays in deep shadow, only controlled narrow soft champagne/silver rim light on roofline, hood, fender and a hint of wheels reveals the real car shape. Elegant aggressive mood. BACKGROUND is an uninterrupted flat warm almost-black matching website #0f0e0d, completely featureless, with the exact same near-black tone at ALL FOUR EDGES so the image blends seamlessly into CSS. No showroom, garage, buildings, landscape, sky, pavement, grid, haze, spotlights, visible studio fixtures, floor line, reflection or horizon. No broad bright illumination of the whole body, no glowing outline effect, no CGI, no illustration. Color in the shadowed paint may hint at graphite, muted wine, warm beige or deep olive, NEVER red. COMPOSITION FOR WEBSITE CONTENT: the central vertical 40 percent (x=30%-70%) must remain visually empty and almost-black; the car is placed exclusively toward the requested outer edge, with its most recognizable parts OUTSIDE the center, and does not span the center. Leave upper 35 percent dark and empty as well. The vehicle should be a real photographic subject discernible through rims of light, not a uniformly hidden black blob. No text, watermarks, license-plate text, people or props.
Specific car and composition: BMW M4 Competition G82 in graphite metallic. Head-on frontal view, camera level with grille; unmistakable tall twin kidney grille, wide low muscular bumper, correct LED headlight shapes. Position car on FAR RIGHT of the wide canvas, occupying roughly rightmost 28 percent width, all front including mirrors inside frame, lower-right composition. Upper hood and shoulders are defined by faint controlled neutral/champagne light. Both white headlights ON, crisp and controlled, no bloom spilling toward center. Fine freshly-washed beaded water droplets catch tiny highlights on hood and bumper, pristine dark paint, no rainfall. Entire central 40 percent and left are completely empty matching near-black. This is a dark isolated realistic M4 emerging from shadow, NOT a bright full-body product shot.
